name: Myanmar
value: Civil war; no major city changed hands
summary: Arakan Army presses Sittwe; civil war continues, no major city changed hands
state: Fighting continued in Rakhine, Sagaing, Shan and Chin in late October: the Arakan Army reported sinking junta vessels near Sittwe on 26 Oct as it tightens pressure on the Rakhine capital (Irrawaddy), and resistance media reported a junta air strike on Sittwe that killed 11 civilians on 23 Oct (unverified). No major city had changed hands as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice; much of Myanmar is unsafe for travel.

sources.title: The Irrawaddy — Myanmar Navy loses 3 more ships as Arakan Army tightens Sittwe noose

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.
